_description: Unit passports (step 1 of the battle simulator, docs/en/training/units.md): what decides a fight, from the game's database. Written by py -3.14 -m tools.nn.units.

engines.n.source: an artillery unit's guns (land_units.num_engines with land_units.engine; no `engines` for a unit without)

engines.type.source: battlefield_engines.engine_type (Generic_3_Crew: the animation set with 3 crew places, R-work artillery_rules.md 5)

engines.crew_per_engine.source: ours: the number in engines.type (3) - the men a gun needs to fire (the game's code names no number: the probe 'crew under fire' to check)

engines.hp.source: the gun's battle_entities.hit_points + land_units.bonus_hit_points (425 + 48 the Empire's)

engines.radii_ratio.source: the gun's battle_entities.radii_ratio (a capsule's or an ellipse's; 1 a circle)

engines.turn_deg_s.source: the gun's battle_entities.turn_speed, deg/s (45): the unit's speed.turn_deg_s

engines.fire_arc_deg.source: the gun's battle_entities.fire_arc_close / 2 (25): the unit's missile.fire_arc_deg

spacing.h.source: unit_spacings.close_formation_spacing_horizontal: a man's place across the front in close formation, m
spacing.h.checked: data/roster widths: front = (files - 1) h, files = floor(width / h)

hp_per_man.source: battle_entities.hit_points + land_units.bonus_hit_points (+ the mount's battle_entities.hit_points of a mounted unit: the charge probe 28.10, Empire Knights 6480 = 60 x (8 + 8 + 92))

hp_total.source: hp_per_man * men (+ engines.n x engines.hp of an artillery unit: one number for the crew and the guns, as the game's card)

mass.source: battle_entities.mass (a mounted unit: its mount's, mounts.entity - as radius_m, radii_ratio, speed.*)

size.source: battle_entities.size; a mounted unit the larger of the rider's and the mount's (medium and above is 'large': bonus v large, charge defence v large; build/diag_cav/mechanic.md M1)

height_m.source: battle_entities.height; a mounted unit the taller of the rider and the mount (the warhorse 2.0, the demigryph 2.3; the rider 1.8)

radii_ratio.source: battle_entities.radii_ratio: an ellipse or a capsule body (shape 'ellipse', 'capsule') is radius long and radius x this across (the Brood Horror's capsule 3.8 x 0.36: 7.6 m long, 2.74 m across); 1 a circle (every man)

body_shape.source: battle_entities.shape (a mounted unit its mount's): circle, ellipse or capsule (a capsule: two half circles of radius x radii_ratio joined by straight sides 2 radius (1 - radii_ratio) long)

knock_ignore.source: battle_entities.knock_interrupts_ignore_chance, % (a mounted unit its mount's): the chance a man stays on his feet when a blow or a body would knock him back, down or flying (the game's program, build/diag_skv_mon/mechanic.md M5: a roll 0-100 below it; the Brood Horror 60, the Rat Ogre Mutant 65, Rat Ogres 20, infantry 0)

hit_reaction_ignore.source: battle_entities.hit_reactions_ignore_chance, %: the chance a man takes no hit reaction (the Brood Horror 70, the Mutant 65, Rat Ogres 20; the simulator has no hit reactions)

melee.weapon_length.source: melee_weapons.weapon_length, m (the Brood Horror's 7, the Mutant's 6, Rat Ogres' 2, a spear 1): no rule of the simulator reads it (build/diag_skv_mon/units.md 4.9)

speed.walk.source: battle_entities.walk_speed, m/s (a mounted unit its mount's, an artillery unit its gun's: 2.0, run 2.0 - the attribute cant_run; the speed.* and turn_deg_s alike)

speed.charge_distance.source: battle_entities.charge_distance_commence_run, m: an attacking unit closes the last this many metres to its target at its charge speed (30 infantry, 35 lords; the melee probe: the last 30 m at 3.65-3.88 m/s, run 3.0)

speed.charge_pose_distance.source: battle_entities.charge_distance_adopt_charge_pose, m: an attacking unit takes its charge pose this far from its target (25 infantry, 30 lords; the morale probe: the charge's +15 morale starts at a gap of 24.6-27.5 m)

speed.turn_deg_s.source: battle_entities.turn_speed, deg/s: how fast a man (a model) turns (patch 6.1: horse cavalry 100 -> 120 deg/s, and 120 in the DB)

melee.magic.source: melee_weapons.is_magical: magical attacks - the censer, the plain Giant Rats' claws

melee.flaming.source: melee_weapons.ignition_amount > 0: flaming attacks (the RPFM schema: 'if set to a value higher than 0, it will deal fire damage'; Knights of the Blazing Sun's lance 1.0)

melee.contact_phase.source: melee_weapons.contact_phase: the contact effect a blow lays on its target (its numbers in the document's contact_phases)

armour_material.source: unit_armour_types.audio_type: the armour's sound type (body, leather, chainmail, ...)

hiding_scalar.source: land_units.hiding_scalar: the unit's own share of an enemy's spotting distance (stealth: a Gutter Runner is seen within 0.8 of it)

spotting.scrub.source: land_units.spot_dist_scrub, m: how far the unit sees a hidden enemy out of woods (80; the Jezzails 160) - the simulator's open ground (tools/nn/sim/stealth.py)

spotting.tree.source: land_units.spot_dist_tree, m: the same into woods (60; the Jezzails 160); no woods in the simulator

projectile_resistance.source: battle_entities.projectile_penetration_resistance: what a man adds to a penetrating projectile's counter (1 infantry, 2 the Giant Rats; the RPFM schema: 'higher number means this entity can stop projectiles more easily'); a mounted unit the mount's (the warhorse 2, the demigryph 3)

projectile_speed_keep.source: battle_entities.projectile_penetration_speed_change: the share of its speed a projectile keeps passing through the man (0.9 men, 0.95 Skaven); a mounted unit the mount's (0.85)

spells.source: ours: SPELLS - the caster's rank-1 spell (character_skill_nodes.points_on_creation; build/magic/plan.md 1); only on casters

combat_potential.melee.source: main_units.melee_cp: the unit's melee combat potential (the army-destruction strength with its abilities' cp, config/nn/abilities.json; build/movelords)

combat_potential.missile.source: main_units.missile_cp: its missile combat potential (counts by the ammunition left)

missile.ammo.source: land_units.primary_ammo, per man; per gun of an artillery unit (missile.ammo_per 'engine': the projectiles - 198 Helblaster = 22 x 9 bullets, R-work artillery_rules.md 4)

missile.ammo_per.source: ours: 'man', or 'engine' for an artillery unit

missile.direct.source: projectiles.trajectory_sight == 'low' (ours): flat, fixed-speed fire (guns) that needs a clear line past friendly units (docs/en/game/mechanics/missiles.md: `low` flat; `dual_low_fixed` switches to an arc when blocked, `fixed` arcs)

missile.marksmanship.source: projectiles.marksmanship_bonus: 10 for our arrows, slings and pistol, 15 for the Night Runners' sling; added to land_units.accuracy in the spread (ours, tools/nn/sim/missile.py)

missile.fire_arc_deg.source: battle_entities.fire_arc_close / 2 (ours: the column is the full angle, 60 / 70 for our shooters, 360 for throwing stars), degrees each side

missile.penetration_max.source: projectile_penetration_junctions.max_penetration of missile.penetration: the counter a projectile goes on through (each man struck adds his projectile_resistance; -1 no limit, absent 0: it stops in the first)

missile.penetration_cap.source: projectile_penetration_junctions.entity_size_cap of missile.penetration: it passes only a man of a smaller size (very_small < small < medium < large < very_large)

missile.contact_phase.source: projectiles.contact_stat_effect: the contact effect a hit lays on its target (the Ratling Gun's suppressing fire)

missile.fixed_elevation.source: projectiles.fixed_elevation, degrees: the launch angle of a 'fixed' trajectory (the Mortar 50; read only for 'fixed')

missile.can_bounce.source: projectiles.can_bounce (the Great Cannon): no number of the bounce in the database

missile.prefer_central.source: projectiles.prefer_central_targets: the shooter's target man costs + 5 x his distance from his unit's centre - the guns aim at its most central man (build/diag_arty/mechanic.md 1; the Mortar, the cannons, the catapult), else at the man nearest them (the rockets, the Helblaster)

missile.blast.source: projectiles_explosions of missile.explosion (null: none): radius_m detonation_radius, speed detonation_speed (the ring's growth, m/s), damage / ap_damage detonation_damage / _ap, force detonation_force, allies affects_allies, magic is_magical, contact_phase contact_phase_effect, type detonation_type

_missing.collision attack: melee_weapons.collision_attack_max_targets (0 for every unit of the pool; the Hell Pit Abomination 5): not read
_missing.projectile intersection: battle_entities.projectile_intersection_radius_ratio (Rat Ogres 0.8, the Brood Horror 1.25, the Mutant 1.0): whether the program's projectile hit reads it is not known (build/diag_skv_mon/sim_gap.md 21)
_missing.mount turning: battle_entities.min_turning_speed (the warhorse 1.0 m/s, infantry 0) and strafe_speed (3.0): what they do in numbers is not known (build/diag_cav/units.md 4.6)
_missing.charge target pick: battle_entities.charge_distance_pick_target (35 m the warhorse, 30 the demigryph): no reader found in the game's program (build/diag_cav/mechanic.md 8)
_missing.melee weapon type: melee_weapons.melee_weapon_type (lance / sword): no mechanic known to depend on it for our units (weapon_length is in the passport, melee.weapon_length, unread)
_missing.missile.can_fire_over_friendlies: no column of its own: missile.direct (trajectory 'low') says the unit cannot; the others arc over friends (knowledge base, not measured)
_missing.fatigue modifiers per unit: none in land_units / battle_entities; fatigue rules are global (config/nn/game_rules.json, fatigue)
_missing.lord aura per unit: no per-unit radius found; the aura is global (_kv_morale_tables: general_aura_radius, general_inspire_effect_amount_*); a lord is marked by the attribute 'encourages'
_missing.ability and attribute effects: only the keys here: the abilities' numbers are their passports (config/nn/abilities.json), the attributes' rules and every innate effect the catalogue config/nn/effects.json (python -m tools.nn.effects)

_contact_phases.duration_s: special_ability_phases.duration, s (10 for poison, the censer's contagion and suppressing fire - fandom: contact effects last 10 s)
_contact_phases.stats: special_ability_phase_stat_effects rows of the phase: stat, how (add / mult), value
